options.configuration: Public User Agent/Native OIDC; code + S256 PKCE; exact callbacks; no BFF, API grants, SAML, SCIM or brokers

conditions: Use Authorization Code with openid scope, a fresh verifier and code_challenge_method S256; the documented PKCE exchange uses client_id and code_verifier, not a distributed client secret.
Register separate User Agent and Native applications with exact callbacks; validate issuer, state, nonce and tokens in the consuming application.
Cloud documentation is mutable and dated, not release-pinned; actual application settings, deployed behavior and Free-account entitlement have not been verified.

The Free offer at https://zitadel.com/pricing is a scope reference, not a future cost guarantee; this public-client scope excludes confidential BFF, API/service-account grants, SAML, SCIM and upstream brokers.

evidence.summary: The dated OIDC guide recommends code flow and PKCE, documents S256 challenges, registered callbacks, state/nonce and a client_id/code_verifier token exchange. This proposes configuration, not verified Cloud deployment or entitlement.

conditions: Limit this proposal to a public User Agent SPA with code and S256 PKCE; keep client credentials out of browser code.
Use exact registered redirects and narrowly configured origins; test production HTTPS and Development Mode restrictions rather than relying on development wildcards.
Browser callback/token handling, origin policy, local-session logout and lifecycle enforcement remain untested; this is not AuthWeave's confidential Next.js BFF.

evidence.summary: The dated application guide identifies User Agent as client-side SPA and recommends code with PKCE; it describes redirect checks, development-mode restrictions and origins. No live browser integration has been tested.

conditions: Limit this proposal to a public Native mobile client with code and S256 PKCE, separate from User Agent, Web and API registrations; a distributed secret is not confidential.
Application prerequisite: use an external user-agent and a platform-bound return URI under RFC 8252 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8252.html), not a credential-capturing embedded WebView.
Verify the actual OS callback and production Development Mode/redirect policy; custom schemes and passkey app links in the application guide do not prove callback ownership or mobile assurance.
Test issuer/state/nonce, token storage and SDK integration independently; no mobile SDK, platform association, passkey control or application-session enforcement has been verified.

evidence.summary: The dated flow guide classifies native/mobile clients as public and recommends code with PKCE, separately from confidential Web and machine clients. External-browser and callback prerequisites are not evidence of tested platform compatibility.
